t: Din bittul reshut leotan sheshshakechu leareb
s: Din bittul reshut leotan sheshshakechu leareb ubo g' seipim: kekol mishpete bittul lemi sheshshakach velo ereb bachatzero — ken hu bammaboy. Sheim shokcha chatzer achat velo nishtattepa, mebattelet reshutah lishar bene hammaboy o hem lah, ukeshehi mebattelet lahem hi naaset keoreach etzlam, ap al pi sheyyesh bah diyyurim harbeh veen harabbim naasim orechim — mikkol maqom leinyan tiltul bammaboy kol haddiyyurim shebbechatzer nechshabim kedira achat, kevan shekkullam yotzeim lammaboy bepetach echad, dehaynu bepetach hechatzer, ubepetach zeh hu sheoserim bammaboy. Velaken naaset hechatzer leinyan leesor bammaboy keillu hu bayit echad sheddarim bo rabbim. Lepikak kekol mishpete yisrael im hannokri bechatzer — ken hu bammaboy o beir hammuqqepet choma, sheen issur letaltel bemaboy o beir shel nokrim ad sheyyihyu shette chatzerot shel yisrael petuchot letokan vehen oserot zo al zo, azay tzarik liskor min hannokrim. Abal bechatzer achat shel yisrael, apillu yesh bah harbeh battim — hem chashubim keyachid leinyan tiltul bair, veen tzarik liskor min hannokrim. Vehu shettehe hair muqqepet ledira, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"g. Usetam ayarot muqqapot ledira, shebbonin battim techilla veachar kak maqqipim otam. Abal setam mibtzarim (sheqqorin shela"s) enan muqqapim ledira:

Kesheyyesh bair b' chatzerot shel batte yisrael — tzerikim liskor mikkol chatzer vechatzer shel nokri, veen moil mah sheyyiskeru missar hair. Bammeh debarim amurim? Besar sheen habbattim shello, vegam en lo reshut lehishtammesh bebatte bene hair kelal, vaapillu bishat milchama, shetztzarik lehoshib anshe hammilchama ukele milchamtam bebatte bene hair, eno naaseh al pi hassar ella al pi etza vehanhagat yoatze hammedina, keminhag qetzat ayarot sheen lammelek velassar alehem serara veshultanut ki im ligbot missim yeduim velishpot mishpetehem, abal shear tzorke hair enam naasim raq al pi yoatze hammedina umanhigeha. Abal ayarot shetztzorkehen enam naasim ella al pi hammelek o hassar vehanhagatam, o al pi hammemunnim shellahem, vadday shessekirut mehassar hahu o mehammemunneh o apillu missekiro uleqito (shebbebeto) moil, shehare yesh lo reshut lehoshib anashayv ukele milchamtam bebatte bene hair bishat milchama shello middatam, vekol mi sheyyesh lo reshut lehanniach chapatzayv bebet hannokri o bachatzero — naaseh kiskiro uleqito, veyakol lehaskir reshuto shello middato. Vaapillu sekiro uleqito shel zeh hannaaseh kiskiro uleqito yakol lehaskir, kemo shennitbaer besimman shp"b:

Yisreelim haddarim bechatzer achat beir shel nokrim hammuqqepet choma, veaberu yisreelim acherim derek sham venitaksenu bechatzer acheret shel nokri — enam oserim bair ad leachar l' yom, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a beoreach shennitarach bechatzer. Ella shehaorechim — yesh omerim shehem asurim letaltel mechatzeran lammaboy, sheyyisrael haddar beir oser alehem kol meboot hair mittaam shennitbaer sham. Abal yisrael echad haddar bechatzer sheddarim bah nokrim — muttar leyisrael acher sheeno mitaksen bechatzer zo lehotzi ulehaknis mibbatte hannokri o mibbet hayyisrael lechatzer, veen yisrael haddar sham oser alayv, hoil vehu eno shobet kelal bechatzer zo veoreach gamur hu etzel zeh:
